title: 第21章 点到为止第22章 打脸穆灵儿城主庆生宴
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
“天铭，清雪的脸，真的是你医治好的？”
韩正德不可置信的看向楚天铭。
要知道，他为了给韩清雪治病，可是高价请了无数的名医大师。
甚至还厚着脸皮托穆家，将大隋太医院的太医都请来了。
可是结果，别说治愈韩清雪身上的病症，甚至连韩清雪身上的病因都没有找到。
如今韩清雪竟然说楚天铭治好了她脸上的红斑。
他岂能不震惊万分？
楚天铭缓缓点了点头：“是！”
见此，所有人都是面面相觑，震惊的说不出话来。
而之前还嘲讽过楚天铭的穆灵儿，也同样有些吃惊：“没想到这个臭瞎子还有这样的本事！”
穆三娘惊喜的站起身来，连忙走到了韩清雪身前，上下打量着自己的女儿，欣慰道：“清雪，这么说来，你的病已经彻底痊愈了？”
“还没有。”
韩清雪摇了摇头，道：“天铭只是帮我压制了体内的阴火，但是我的那个怪病，还没有被消除掉。”
“原来如此。”
穆三娘美眸一闪，看向楚天铭道：“天铭，你的医术是从何处学来的？”
楚天铭摸了摸下巴，道：“自学的。”
“自学的？”
这样的回答，穆三娘自然是根本不信，那么多名医都束手无策的怪病，楚天铭这么快就帮助韩清雪压制住，这样的厉害医术，怎么可能是靠自学就能做到的。
何况楚天铭才不过十几岁的年纪！
就算他打娘胎里就开始学习医术，恐怕也无法做到！

不过她也没有继续追问下去，而是轻轻一笑：“很好，没想到我的女婿是一个医师，看来当初我和你岳父的确没有看走眼。”
“岳母过誉了。”
楚天铭谦虚回应。
“天铭，清雪身上的病，还会复发么？”
穆三娘有些担心的问道。
“会，不过岳母放心，我会想办法医治好清雪的。”
楚天铭神色坚定的回道。
“嗯，我相信你。”
穆三娘微微颔首。
“表姐，恭喜你恢复了容颜。”
那穆灵儿嘴角一撇，旋即走上前来，口是心非的向着韩清雪恭贺道。
这么多年来，韩清雪是唯一能在颜值上，压制她的存在。
好胜心极强的她，自然是最不希望韩清雪恢复容貌。
不过眼下，在姑母面前，她自然不敢表露出来就是。
“谢谢表妹。”
韩清雪温柔一笑，绝美的笑颜，让在场之人，皆是如沐春风一般。
在这一刻，同样是极品美女的穆灵儿，仿佛一下子就变成了明月面前的斑驳星光，瞬间黯然失色。
“没想到世间还有如此美丽的女子。”
此刻，别说其他人，就连那座位上的李超新不禁看的一呆。
穆灵儿见此，心里不爽到了极点，轻哼一声，看了眼楚天铭，道：“没想到表姐夫竟然还是一个如此厉害的医师，刚才表妹失礼了，还望姐夫不要怪我。”

楚天铭呵呵一笑：“没关系，我不会跟女人一般见识的。”
穆灵儿轻哼一声，黛眉微微一扬，道：“早就听说姐夫乃是天骄楚天铭的堂弟，想必武道天赋也是非比寻常吧，不如跟我未婚夫也切磋一下如何？”
content_en:
"Tian Ming, was it really you who healed Qingxue's face?"
Han Zhengde looked at Chu Tianming in disbelief.
You know, in order to treat Han Qingxue, he hired countless famous doctors at high prices.
He even shamelessly asked the Mu family and invited all the doctors from Sui Imperial Hospital.
But in the end, let alone curing Han Qingxue's illness, not even the cause of Han Qingxue's illness was found.
Now Han Qingxue actually said that Chu Tianming cured the red spots on her face.
How could he not be extremely shocked?
Chu Tianming nodded slowly: "Yes!"
Seeing this, everyone looked at each other, shocked and speechless.
Mu Ling'er, who had ridiculed Chu Tianming before, was also a little surprised: "I didn't expect this blind blind man to have such abilities!"
Mu Sanniang stood up in surprise, walked to Han Qingxue quickly, looked at her daughter up and down, and said happily: "Qingxue, so your illness has been completely cured?"
"Not yet."
Han Qingxue shook her head and said: "Tianming just helped me suppress the Yin Fire in my body, but my strange disease has not been eliminated yet."
"That's it."
Mu Sanniang's beautiful eyes flashed and she looked at Chu Tianming and said, "Tianming, where did you learn your medical skills?"
Chu Tianming touched his chin and said, "Self-taught."
"Self-taught?"
Mu Sanniang naturally didn't believe such an answer. There were so many strange diseases that famous doctors were unable to cure, and Chu Tianming helped Han Qingxue suppress them so quickly. How could such powerful medical skills be achieved by self-study?
What's more, Chu Tianming is only a teenager!
Even if he started learning medical skills from his mother's womb, he probably wouldn't be able to do it!
However, she did not continue to ask, but smiled softly: "Very good, I didn't expect that my son-in-law is a doctor. It seems that your father-in-law and I did not make a mistake."
"Mother-in-law is too praised."
Chu Tianming responded modestly.
"Tian Ming, will Qingxue's illness relapse?"
Mu Sanniang asked worriedly.
"Yes, but don't worry, mother-in-law, I will find a way to cure Qingxue."
Chu Tianming replied firmly.
"Well, I believe you."
Mu Sanniang nodded slightly.
"Cousin, congratulations on your restored appearance."
Mu Ling'er curled her lips and immediately stepped forward, congratulating Han Qingxue duplicitously.
Over the years, Han Qingxue was the only one who could suppress her in terms of appearance.
Being extremely competitive, she naturally didn't want Han Qingxue to regain her appearance.
But right now, she naturally didn't dare to show it in front of her aunt.
"Thank you cousin."
Han Qingxue smiled softly, and her beautiful smile made everyone present feel like they were bathed in spring breeze.
At this moment, Mu Ling'er, who was also a top beauty, seemed to suddenly become the mottled starlight in front of the bright moon, and was instantly eclipsed.
"I never thought there was such a beautiful woman in the world."
At this moment, not to mention other people, even Li Chaoxin in that seat couldn't help but stare blankly.
Seeing this, Mu Ling'er felt extremely unhappy. She snorted, glanced at Chu Tianming, and said, "I didn't expect my cousin-in-law to be such a powerful doctor. My cousin was rude just now. I hope my brother-in-law doesn't blame me."
Chu Tianming chuckled: "It doesn't matter, I don't know how to deal with women."
Mu Ling'er snorted, raised her eyebrows slightly, and said: "I have long heard that my brother-in-law is the cousin of the genius Chu Tianming. He must have extraordinary talent in martial arts. How about we compete with my fiancé?"
